NiagaraService.add_emitter:
X.add_emitter(system_path, emitter_asset_path, emitter_name="") -> str
Add an emitter to a Niagara System.
Works like Unreal's "Add Emitter to your System" dialog.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the system
    emitter_asset_path (str): Path to emitter asset, or empty/"minimal" for a minimal empty emitter
    emitter_name (str): Optional custom name for the emitter

Returns:
    str: Name of the added emitter (empty on failure) Example: # Add existing emitter name = unreal.NiagaraService.add_emitter("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "/Game/VFX/NE_Sparks") # Add minimal empty emitter (like UI's "Add Minimal Emitter" button) name = unreal.NiagaraService.add_emitter("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "minimal") name = unreal.NiagaraService.add_emitter("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "")  # Also creates minimal
NiagaraService.add_user_parameter:
X.add_user_parameter(system_path, parameter_name, parameter_type, default_value="") -> bool
Add a user-exposed parameter to a Niagara System.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the system
    parameter_name (str): Name for the parameter (without namespace)
    parameter_type (str): Type (Float, Int, Bool, Vector, Color, etc.)
    default_value (str): Default value as string

Returns:
    bool: True if successful Example: unreal.NiagaraService.add_user_parameter("/Game/VFX/NS_Fire", "SpawnRate", "Float", "50.0")
NiagaraService.copy_emitter:
X.copy_emitter(source_system_path, source_emitter_name, target_system_path, new_emitter_name="") -> str
Copy an emitter from one Niagara System to another.
Works like copy/paste in the Niagara Editor - copies the emitter with all its
modules, renderers, and settings to the target system.

Args:
    source_system_path (str): Full path to the source system
    source_emitter_name (str): Name of emitter to copy
    target_system_path (str): Full path to the target system
    new_emitter_name (str): Optional new name for the copied emitter (uses original name if empty)

Returns:
    str: Name of the added emitter (empty on failure) Example: # Copy emitter from one system to another name = unreal.NiagaraService.copy_emitter( "/Game/VFX/NS_Source", "Flames", "/Game/VFX/NS_Target", "CopiedFlames") # Copy with same name name = unreal.NiagaraService.copy_emitter( "/Game/VFX/NS_Source", "Flames", "/Game/VFX/NS_Target")

NiagaraService.move_emitter:
X.move_emitter(system_path, emitter_name, new_index) -> bool
Move/reorder an emitter to a new position in the system.
Changes the visual order of emitters in the Niagara Editor graph.

Args:
    system_path (str): Full path to the system
    emitter_name (str): Name of emitter to move
